Elon Musk’s xAI is facing questions regarding who is ultimately responsible for the generation of harmful content via generative artificial intelligence tools. These problems lie at the core of multiple legal cases involving xAI’s Grok chatbot, with plaintiffs in three U.S. states seeking legal recourse against xAI over the creation of CSAM material.

A woman from Wisconsin alleges xAI’s Grok tool was used to generate sexually explicit images of her, based on a photo from her middle school graduation, taken when she was 14 years old.
